commits.message: Garage, empty. The door is where the light comes from.
Three plants and the knot. Nothing happens yet.
Lamp, fan, suitcase. Everything got closer.
Rearranged. Monstera toward the door, fan beside it. The others went back inside.
Chair. Sat down. Nothing to keep.
